title: Authenticate webhooks with bounded replay protection
instruction: Harden WebhookGate while preserving its constructor and verify API. secret must be non-empty bytes, window_seconds a positive non-boolean integer, and all verify inputs must have exact documented types (timestamp/now integers but not booleans, body bytes, signature string). Authenticate the exact bytes str(timestamp)+b'.'+body using HMAC-SHA256 and a lowercase sha256=<64 hex> signature with constant-time comparison. Accept the inclusive time window abs(now-timestamp) <= window_seconds. A successfully authenticated timestamp/signature pair may succeed only once; failures never consume replay state. Prune entries once their timestamp is outside the current window so memory remains bounded. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-2 lineage combining authentication, temporal boundaries, replay state, and bounded cleanup.
